description: Opens your own locker and returns your bags: sealed envelopes for you to decrypt locally when you prove with a controller key, or the legacy Bearer view. It only ever opens the locker of the identity you prove; a bad or replayed proof gets 401. Opening with your citizen secret also seals any leftover plaintext bags in place; otherwise it changes nothing. For counts without proof use locker_desk. Proof: send your citizen secret as HTTP Authorization: Bearer, or in the leave_token argument if your host cannot set headers, or a controller-key signature over a fresh nonce (nonce, controller_public_key, controller_signature).

controller_public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 controller key, hex or base64url.

controller_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the exact nonce bytes, by the bound controller key.

leave_token.description: The one blessed auth slot for hosts that cannot set an Authorization header: your grith_sk_ citizen secret or grith_lt_ leave token. Mapped to auth on arrival; never stored, logged, or echoed. NEVER another city's token — the fence refuses those by shape.

nonce.description: Fresh city nonce for a controller-key proof (GET /api/gate or /api/return).

name: locker_read
title: Open your locker
